title: Ashura
body:
For Ashura may Allah bless Mumin and Muslims, four rakats - after fatiha, eleven times ikhlas. Allah make
this prayer for heavenly supprt for Muslims today, four rakats, tenth of Muharram.
Shukr ya rabbi, Shukr ya Rabbi, tawba ya Rabbi tawba ya rabbi. Thank Allah Almighty that we have reached
before 2000 last tenth Muharram today, in second millenium, last Ashura that we reached. Who knows that
next year we are going to be with Mahdi, aleyhi salam, Allah knows. We are looking and waiting for when
Mahdi comes, aleyhi salam. We are waiting. This is second millenium and its' last Muharram, the last tenth
of Muharram of the second millenium. It is very holy day that every Prophet and their umma respected, and
from respect of this holy day, fasted. Prophet was saying, "If I reach next year I am going to fast this day."
Jewish people were fasting for today, but only one day, and Rasul Allah, SAW, said that, "We must not do as
Jewish people are doing, we must keep another kind of celebration, and another kind of worship to Allah
Almighty - as they are fasting one day then we must fast two days or three days," either you may fast 9,10,
and 11, or 9 and 10, or 10th with 11th. you may fast three days, you may fast [...] to follow any other religion
and their worship. Islam is original, it is not taking from this, not taking from that, taking nothing from the
Torah and taking nothing from the Bible. Taking nothing from Moses or taking nothing from Jesus Christ.
No. Islam is in its full originality.
Everything is original in Islam. It is not necessary to imitate or to follow anything from other religions like

Judiasm and Christianity. No. They are in limits for their religion, but Muslims are not in limits. They are in
limits because their Prophets were sent only for the Children of Israel, not to others. But the Seal of Prophets,
Rasul Allah, sal Allahu aleyhi wa sallam, Sayyidina Muhammad, peace be upon him, has been sent for all
nations, for all mankind. Therefore there must be originality in Islam and we are not taking anything from
Moses or Jesus, peace be upon them. Sayyididna Muhammad,peace be upon him, his shari'a, his rules, are
new ones. Original ones. We are not in need to take something from them or something from this. Therefore
he never asked to follow book-given to people like Jewish people and Christians. "They are fasting one day,"
he said, "so we must fast two days or three days to keep our originality." And now we are following Christians,
we are following Jewish ways, and we are leaving the originality of Islam.
It is a blame for those who are trying to change their Islamic ways and to follow fully Christainity or Judaism,
and therefore I am saying that to be number one among people or in Divine Presence - if you have a chance to
be number one, don't lose it and be number two - no. If you have been granted a chance to be number one,
why you are going to lose it? Islam - that is number one - don't change it, don't change its rules and follow
Christian's rules or Judaism, Jewish customs. No. We have full honour and full respect in the Divine
Presence and we have fully original rules, but now people are accepting to be number one billion, not to be
number one, number two, or three, they are saying there are so many people - we may be the last one, that is
okay. That characteristic is from our ego. Ego, ego represents total laziness, total laziness. Ego - no-one can
reach the limits of our ego's laziness - therefore they are saying it doesn't matter, no need to be number one,
it is enough to be last, so that no-one is after us. We should be free as the last ones, no one following us, free
to be sultan of lazy ones. That is giving dishonour to Muslims. Dishonour, dishonouring them, there is no
more honour on those who say we are happy to be the last one. If they say they are happy to be the last one
that means they are happy not to be glorious, they are saying there is no need for us to be glorious ones, we
may be last and that is okay for us. That is the opinion of our egos. Therefore, 20th century Muslims are
never following the rules of Islam because if they were follwing the rules of Islam they should be number one,
but instead they are saying, "We are very humble people, we are happy to be to be last instead of first." And
Allah Almighty making them dishonoured people. Everywhere Muslims now - the non-Muslim world never
accepts them on their level, they are saying, "Those people must be last ones. We are first, those people must
be last. We use them as we are using animals and they are very happy to be our animals."

Yes, it's sorrowful what I am saying, and I am sorry about it, but Muslims are very happy to be servants of
non-Muslims, to work for them - and their work is perhaps the dirtiest work - but imitated people in Islam
are very happy to follow Western ways even when they are the last ones, not the first one. And through that
opinion there is no chance for the Muslim world to be number one on earth, The Christian world are always
number one because the Muslim world is running after Western civilisation and are asking to be westernised
Muslims. No. If you are going to be westernise then your Islam is finished. You must leave Islam there, if you
are asking to be westernised people, you must leave Islam there and just jump to be with them. Therefore, the
European Community, that is free market, they are saying to Turks, those who are very proud ones like
Turkey - you know Turkey? Big bird. And our Turks are asking to come into the European Market, to join
those people and they're saying, "No, you can't be with us because we are asking that the ones who are with
us are from ourselves - you are Muslims, you can't be with us, and we can't trust you. We are number one and
you are last so we will never accept you to sit on the same stage with us."
Therefore, Prophet said that you must not follow book-given people, either Christians or Jewish, because if
you follow them you lose your honour and you also lose your respect in the Divine Presence. If you are
following the Christian world or the non-Muslim world you will be dishonoured through nations and there
will be no respect for you in the Divine Presence. And people are running after non-Muslim countries.
Malaysia is asking for their government to be a westernised government - they are leaving sharia'at.
Indonesia is the same. Pakistan - the same. Hindustan - the same, Ceylon - the same, Afghan - the same, Iran
- the same, Saudia - the same, Turkey - the same, Syria - the same, Baghdad - the same, Egyptians - the same,
Sudanese people - the same, Libya - the same, Tunis - the same, Algeria - the same, and Maghrib - the same.
They are never happy to be number one Muslims. They are asking to be the last ones because they are
preferring the non-Muslim world and they are asking to have westernised governments. They think that, "If
we are not going to be westernised, Western governments and nations are never going to accept us." Yes, it is
true, they are never going to accept you, but Allah may accept you. But nations, Muslim nations, are throwing
that away and are saying that, "We prefer our honour to be with Western nations, we are not asking for our
honour to be in the Divine Presence." Therefore the Prophet said, "Don't do what Jewish people or bookgiven people do - make it the opposite. They are fasting one day, you must fast two days or three days. You
must change everything!" And we are going to change everything that we are imitating from Western
countries, up to the end of this year we must change everything. A storm, a typhoon, should come that will

take away billions. May Allah bless you and forgive me.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Aziz Allah,
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Karim Allah,
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhan Allah,
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah!
Real Sultan is Allah and He is granting that real ones will be on earth, sultans for shari'a - Muslims. Ya Rabbi,
shari'at ul-sultan
Lefke - 26.04.1999
